State of play: 61% of respondents in the district said they disapprove of Trump, while 37% said they approve, according to the 2026 Colorado Latino Policy Agenda survey.

Zoom in: Evans, who is Latino, has a negative rating among Latino voters in the district, with 42% disapproving of him, while 34% approve.

What they're saying: Axios Denver has reached out to Evans' campaign for a response. [...] Editor's note: This story has been corrected to reflect that the 61% of respondents in the district who said they disapprove of President Trump reflects a 13% jump (not drop) from 2025.
